name: io.github.llmops-pro/albyhub-admin-mcp
description: Node-admin operations on an Alby Hub Lightning node via its HTTP API: node info, balances, channels, sub-wallet apps — write operations gated behind safety knobs, plus a generic proxy_request escape hatch.

environmentVariables.name: ALBYHUB_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Alby Hub instance

environmentVariables.name: ALBYHUB_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set true to block all write operations (recommended for first-time setup)
